response.sql: WITH eq AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS overall_avg FROM eq), grp AS (SELECT AVG(eq.avg_hum) AS group_avg FROM eq CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE eq.avg_hum > o.overall_avg) SELECT eq.equipref, eq.avg_hum AS average_humidity, eq.avg_hum - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall_avg, eq.avg_hum - g.group_avg AS diff_from_group_mean FROM eq CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN grp g WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND g.group_avg IS NOT NULL AND eq.avg_hum > o.overall_avg ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
